news.headline: uniQure Shares Fade After AMT-130 Filing, But William Blair Sees 58% Upside
news.summary: QURE shares opened up roughly 6% but closed down about 3% the day the BLA was filed, a 'sell the news' reaction after months of anticipation. William Blair resumed coverage with an Outperform rating and a $73 fair value estimate, calling AMT-130 a potential first disease-modifying therapy for Huntington's as early as H1 2027.

news.headline: uniQure Filed for Huntington's Approval; Acceptance Is the Next Catalyst, Analyst Says
news.summary: Following the BLA submission, analysts framed FDA acceptance of the filing (and a decision on the requested priority review) as the next de-risking catalyst for the stock. If priority review is granted, analysts project a potential accelerated-approval action date around late April to early May 2027.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Submission of BLA for AMT-130 (Ifezuntirgene Inilparvovec) in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure submitted a Biologics License Application to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 for Huntington's disease, and simultaneously submitted a Marketing Authorisation Application to the UK's MHRA. The filings are supported by three-year Phase I/II data showing high-dose AMT-130 produced a statistically significant (about 75%) slowing of disease progression on the cUHDRS scale versus a propensity-matched external control from the Enroll-HD database.

news.headline: uniQure Submits BLA for Gene Therapy in Huntington Disease
news.summary: Trade press coverage of the filing noted AMT-130 (an AAV5-delivered miQURE-technology gene therapy silencing the huntingtin gene) would, if approved, be the first disease-modifying treatment for Huntington's disease. The company also said it plans to present a four-year data analysis from the ongoing Phase I/II studies, covering 24 patients across the high- and low-dose cohorts, before the end of Q3 2026.

news.headline: uniQure (QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on QURE from $60 to $75 while maintaining an Overweight rating, following the company's Q2 2026 results and confirmation of FDA alignment on the accelerated-approval BLA pathway for AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported that final FDA meeting minutes confirmed alignment on submitting the AMT-130 BLA under the accelerated approval pathway using three-year data, and disclosed $810.3 million in cash and investments as of June 30, 2026, sufficient to fund operations into 2030. The company also amended its Hercules Capital loan facility to extend the draw window on a $100 million term-loan tranche, and flagged early Fabry disease (AMT-191) and epilepsy (AMT-260) data with further updates on both expected in H1 2027.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 Phase I/II data analysis
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to present a four-year follow-up data analysis (safety, tolerability and efficacy) from the ongoing Phase I/II studies of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, covering 24 patients across the high- and low-dose cohorts, building on the three-year data used in the BLA.

catalysts.label: FDA decision on BLA filing acceptance / priority review
catalysts.detail: The FDA is expected to complete its standard 60-day review of whether to formally accept the AMT-130 BLA for filing and to rule on uniQure's request for priority review, which would shorten the subsequent review clock to six months.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: uniQure is expected to report third-quarter 2026 financial results and provide a pipeline/regulatory update, with consensus estimating an EPS loss of roughly $0.81 per share.

catalysts.when: 2027 (~late April-early May, if priority review granted)
catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: If priority review is granted, analysts project the FDA action date for accelerated approval of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease could land around late April to early May 2027, roughly six months after the 60-day filing review concludes.

catalysts.label: FDA feedback on confirmatory Phase 3 trial design
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to finalize discussions with the FDA on the design (including use of a concurrent standard-of-care control instead of sham surgery) and statistical analysis plan for the required post-approval confirmatory study.

catalysts.label: MHRA decision on UK Marketing Authorisation Application
catalysts.detail: The UK's MHRA is reviewing uniQure's MAA for ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130) in Huntington's disease, submitted alongside the FDA BLA; if approved, AMT-130 could reach patients in two countries in 2027.

catalysts.label: Fabry disease (AMT-191) and epilepsy (AMT-260) clinical updates
catalysts.detail: Company guidance from Q2 2026 results points to further clinical data updates for the AMT-191 Fabry disease program (paused in mid/high-dose cohorts pending an FDA-agreed monitoring plan after Grade 3 liver enzyme elevations) and the AMT-260 refractory epilepsy program.

pulse: uniQure hit its biggest milestone yet on September 2, 2026, formally submitting the AMT-130 Biologics License Application to the FDA (with a parallel MHRA filing in the UK) for accelerated approval in Huntington's disease, using three-year Phase I/II data showing a ~75% slowing of disease progression versus external control; the company has requested priority review, and analysts now peg a possible approval action date around late April/early May 2027 if that's granted. The stock's reaction was muted ('sell the news') even as William Blair, Wells Fargo and other analysts reiterated bullish targets ($73-$75+) citing a substantially de-risked regulatory path, and the company enters the review period well capitalized with $810 million in cash extending its runway into 2030. Near-term catalysts are the FDA's filing-acceptance/priority-review decision (~60 days out), a four-year AMT-130 data update expected before quarter-end, and the Q3 2026 earnings report, alongside continued progress on the HEMGENIX hemophilia B franchise (commercialized by CSL Behring) and the earlier-stage Fabry and epilepsy gene therapy programs.
